notes.title: Repurpose 3.0/ Part 3 update
notes.content:
Hello there folks! 

The long-awaited 3.0 update has arrived. My team and I face many hardships that caused this update to take longer than expected, but hopefully it will be worth it once you get your hands on it. 

In terms of content this will be the final one Repurpose receives

Happy holidays!

Additions

-Added 100K to word count
-Ability to explore all routes at leisure once cheri’s route is completed. 
-New illustrations
-New characters
-Voice lines for 1 new (old?) character
-Once cheri’s route is “finished” players can “complete” the game’s story with the character of their choice
-Harem ending if you play all 9 character’s final storyline.

Fixes
-Minor bugs 
-Minor spelling errors

Future updates

-Fix remaining bugs and errors
'Add 3.0’s illustrations to gallery
